reason: The PR changes the MIP implication cache from one growing vector with offsets to per-literal vectors, targeting a stated memory-movement bottleneck in solver search.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Reducing relocation of cached implications should lower MIP probing and separation overhead; search decisions and total solve time must be measured end to end.
workload_exposure_plan: Use MIP instances with binary implications and active probing, record implication counts and solver time, and compare the same original models on base and PR builds.
mathematical_risk: Incorrect cache indexing or reuse may create invalid implications, cuts, or bounds and can change feasibility or optimality claims.
independent_check_plan: Check returned solutions against original MIP models and compare status, primal values, and valid dual bounds with an independent reference on tractable instances.
hidden_generalization_plan: Evaluate paired held-out MIP instances from multiple structural families with fixed budgets, seeds, and failure accounting.
overlap_review: This PR shares the exact pre-PR commit with cut-aging PR #690. Its implication-cache representation is a different code path, but the same generic Agent instruction and MIP workload would be a duplicate task. Require a distinct implication-focused goal and an independently triggered frozen workload before counting it.
causal_chain: Per-literal implication vectors avoid relocating a global cache; this can lower probing overhead, but altered cache access can also change reductions and search.
structural_trigger: Binary MIP instances that create and reuse many literal implications during probing.
activation_probe: Count computeImplications calls, stored implication entries, and probing time on the base and PR builds.
instance_selection_rule: Choose binary MIP structural families and a non-triggering control before observing hidden performance; retain every selected instance.
same_snapshot_distinction: PR #693 may count separately from #690 only with an implication-cache search goal and a frozen binary-implication workload whose activation differs from cut aging; identical Agent input or only a new task ID does not qualify.
resource_risk: Per-literal vectors may increase allocator overhead or peak memory even if cache movement falls.
